results.question: How is the Semester Grade Point Average (SGPA) computed mathematically?
results.generated_answer:
The Semester Grade Point Average (SGPA) is calculated as a weighted average of the grades earned by a student in all the courses credited by her/him, reflecting her/his academic performance in the respective semester [Academic Regulations and Degree Requirements, p.10; Academic Programmes Rules & Regulations (2022 Onwards), p.12; M.Tech Academic Regulations and Guidelines, p.14]. 

If the grade points associated with the letter grades earned by a student in $N$ courses registered during a semester are $G_1, G_2, \dots G_N$, and the corresponding credits are $C_1, C_2, \dots C_N$, the SGPA is computed mathematically as:

$$\text{SGPA} = \frac{C_1 G_1 + C_2 G_2 + \dots + C_N G_N}{C_1 + C_2 + \dots + C_N} = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{N} C_i G_i}{\sum_{i=1}^{N} C_i}$$

*(Sources: [Academic Regulations and Degree Requirements, p.10], [Academic Programmes Rules & Regulations (2022 Onwards), p.12], [M.Sc. Academic Programmes Regulations, p.13], [M.Tech Academic Regulations and Guidelines, p.14])*
